reconstruction.sq09_candidate: Complete continuation-to-surface-aqueous transfer at activation, ordered before downstream runoff, infiltration, sorption-after-arrival, transformation and atmospheric loss.
reconstruction.sq10_result: Generic external literature did not unlock material mapping or process-specific validation.
reconstruction.sq11_claim: A two-stage pre-registered design can be qualified as capable of discriminating the transfer hypothesis, but no physical evidence is generated in the repository workunit.

H1_protocol_design_itself_is_process_val.reason: A design and schema create a future evidence interface only. They do not observe the physical process.

H2_any_post_rewetting_soil_receiver_refu.reason: SQ09 orders sorption-after-arrival after continuation-to-aqueous transfer. SQ11 now requires temporal/source evidence for a direct alternative receiver before treating soil uptake as refutation.

H3_any_post_rewetting_atmospheric_loss_r.reason: Atmospheric loss after demonstrated aqueous arrival is compatible with M1 and is used for mass reconstruction, not automatic failure.

H4_stage_A_is_too_artificial_to_be_scien.reason: Stage A deliberately isolates the primary transfer. Its result is bounded to the tested material and environment and requires Stage B or equivalent evidence for representative lifecycle ordering.

H5_stage_A_alone_can_establish_universal.reason: The design explicitly prohibits universalization from a single material/condition and retains the separate material-to-model-state mapping gate.

H6_15N_must_be_mandatory.reason: Source attribution is mandatory, but the analytical method is not. A tracer is strongly recommended where background N would otherwise make attribution inadequate; without adequate attribution the result is inconclusive.

H7_no_fixed_replicate_count_makes_the_de.reason: A universal n would be invented without variance or instrument evidence. The executing study must predeclare replication/randomization from pilot variance, analytical precision and a stated power or equivalent design criterion.

H8_no_universal_numeric_epsilon_makes_th.reason: Decision thresholds are required to be predeclared from measurement uncertainty, recovery performance and quantification limits. This is stricter than an arbitrary model-wide epsilon.

H9_complete_first_sample_recovery_proves.reason: SQ11 qualifies support only at the declared experimental temporal resolution.

H10_residue_characterization_in_one_expe.reason: It can map the tested residue only. Extension to the ANIMO continuation state and intended application envelope still requires a separate traceable argument.

H11_synthetic_discrimination_examples_ar.reason: They document decision categories only and are explicitly excluded from Class-F evidence.

H12_evidence_generation_is_complete_beca.reason: No physical observations are generated or acquired. External execution or an equivalent traceable dataset remains a hard dependency.

residual_uncertainty: no empirical dry-down/rewetting dataset exists in SQ11
continuation material identity across the ANIMO application envelope remains unresolved
required experimental temporal resolution depends on the executing method
replication and power depend on pilot variance and analytical precision
whether a tested residue maps to the canonical continuation state remains an evidence question
interpretation: The review passes the bounded SQ11 experiment-design qualification. It does not pass the M1 physics candidate and does not claim that evidence generation has occurred.
